coordinateContract: Generated 1536x1024 RGBA atlases, 4 columns by 2 rows. Source bytes copied unchanged. Runtime pivots and visual-facing maps are authoritative in src/home_furniture_catalog.lua; elevated floor projection is 0.5.
runtimeNotes: Alpha ranges 0..254; generated low-alpha haze is discarded below .18 in the runtime shader. Floor lamps have rotationally symmetric geometry; clock side views remain slightly three-quarter and may benefit from later refinement. Surface objects use derived parent-relative poses and share the supporting object's wall-occlusion record.
